compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is from a shopping app named "Jet." The main contents and functions of this screen include:

1. **Header Section:**
   - A navigation menu icon (three horizontal lines) on the top left.
   - The app name "Jet" in the center.
   - A search icon and a shopping cart icon on the top right.

2. **Promotional Banners:**
   - Three promotional messages below the header:
     - "Everyday low prices to start"
     - "Prices drop as you shop"
     - "Fast delivery to your door"

3. **Main Content:**
   - A section titled "BROWSE NEW YEAR, DO YOU" with a "SEE ALL" link on the right.
   - Four product categories displayed with images and labels:
     - "Healthy Snacking" featuring a snack product.
     - "No Stress" featuring a stress relief supplement.
     - "Food Storage" featuring food storage containers.
